user.title: Add an appliance
user.description: Find the cheapest Octopus Agile times to run an appliance.

data_description.name: Used to name the sensors, e.g. sensor.<name>_best_window.
data_description.current_entity: The Octopus Energy 'Current Day Rates' event entity for your import meter.
data_description.future_entity: The Octopus Energy 'Next Day Rates' event entity. It fills in after about 4pm.
data_description.mode: Run in one continuous block, or pick the cheapest half-hours each day.
data_description.run_hours: How long the appliance needs to run. In 'cheapest slots' mode this is the total per day (or per allowed time range).
data_description.min_block_hours: 'Cheapest slots' mode only: shortest time to run in one go, so it isn't switched every half hour. Leave empty for half-hour blocks.
data_description.total_kwh: Total kWh used over the full run time, used to estimate the cost.
data_description.min_start: Optional. Only run after this time of day.
data_description.max_end: Optional. Must finish by this time of day. Can be earlier than the earliest start for overnight ranges, e.g. 22:00 to 06:00.
data_description.enable_binary: Adds a binary sensor that is on while the appliance should be running. Use it to trigger automations.

error.min_block_too_long: The minimum block length can't be longer than the run time.

init.title: Appliance settings
init.description: Changes apply straight away; the plan is recalculated.
